# Before/After Benchmark Report (Structural)

**Generated by:** `python3 benchmarks/token-optimization/harness.py`  
**Honesty:** This kit measures **routing/context/standards structure**. It does **not** claim lower billing tokens or higher quality until live operator runs fill those fields.

## Before (2.4 mental model — documented)

| Issue | Effect |
|-------|--------|
| 13 alwaysApply rules every turn | High fixed prompt cost |
| Cache prompt-only | Repeated xray/architecture digests |
| No execution_mode | Easy to over-delegate |
| No context package tool | Oversized handoffs |
| No standards selector CLI | Risk of loading irrelevant packs |

## After (2.5 structural)

| Control | Effect |
|---------|--------|
| Demoted 3 alwaysApply rules to globs | Lower fixed cost per turn |
| `execution_mode` + escalate-only | Risk-right agent sets |
| `scripts/context/package.py` | Bounded handoffs + size proxy |
| `scripts/standards/select_standards.py` | Progressive packs |
| `scripts/cache/*` | Operational Cache Gate |
| Specialized review lanes | Less duplicate critic text |
| Guardrails rule | Quality non-negotiables explicit |
